gates.amended: gates-v2.json was declared before training. While these nets trained the owner dropped the letters rule on the overlap of the worst character (v2.1), had every rule that a perfect net fails skipped for that group and size (v2.2), then replaced the skip (v2.3): no limit is tighter than the perfect drawing's own score with 10% of room, and a seed that puts every pixel on the right side at every counted size passes. Nearest-to-itself and none-vanished always apply. Every verdict here is v2.3's.
gates.rule: both seeds meet every limit; the seed with the lower mean error at 8x16, 16x32 and 48x96 ships; a failing group is cut in two and each half trained once; a half that fails is left out; a limit tighter than the perfect drawing's own score eased by 10% is applied at that eased value (limits_eased)
